_comment: Orphan requirement citations that existed when this check was introduced (#197). Entries may shrink, never grow. See the module docstring in check_req_citations.py. #213 (2026-09-28): P1A 066 added. It is NOT new debt -- it was orphaned the whole time and the check could not see it, because every file under .moai/specs/ counted as a definition source and quality-report.md:147 mentions the id in passing. Tightening definitions to definition lines in spec.md surfaced it. Whether to restore or retire the requirement is #211's scope (commit bc22093 deleted 46 P1A requirements); until that is decided the citation stays and is recorded here.
